raw.details:
Overview

SATTVA, the Computer Science Society of Kalindi College (University of Delhi), in collaboration with Coders Den, presents the 3rd edition of its flagship inter-college hackathon — Synapse 3.0!

Unleash your creativity, collaborate with brilliant minds, and solve real-world problems.

Registration & Mandatory Requirements:

  1. Google Form (Mandatory):  https://forms.gle/A5QLVTFh6ASrBXuC7 Filling out the Google Form is strictly required. Any team that fails to submit the form will be disqualified without exception.

  2. WhatsApp Group (Mandatory for Updates): Click to Join WhatsApp

Competition Structure:

  • Round 1: Online PPT Submission Round
  • Teams must design and submit a presentation (PPT) outlining their proposed idea, solution architecture, tech stack, and social impact/feasibility.
  • Submissions will be screened and shortlisted by an expert evaluation panel.
  • Round 2: Offline Final Pitch & Hack (Grand Finale)
  • Shortlisted teams from the PPT screening will receive an invitation to Kalindi College campus.
  • Finalists will showcase their prototypes, present their working models, and pitch live before the judging panel.

Hackathon Themes & Problem Tracks:

Participants can build solutions around the following domains:

  • AI / Machine Learning & Automation
  • Healthcare & Assistive Technology
  • FinTech & Web3 / Blockchain
  • Smart Education & EdTech
  • Open Innovation (Build any viable solution solving a real-world challenge)
